title: Whispers of the Hills
excerpt:
After hours buried in alpha, beta, and gamma,
I took a breath, a pause to reclaim my mantra.
I sought the hills, where silence calls,
And left behind the world's loud thralls.
The road unwinds beneath my feet,
Where earth and sky in stillness meet.
The engine's hum, a song so pure,
As nature whispers, calm and sure.
The scent of rain on thirsty earth,
The sweet embrace of simple mirth.
No crowded streets, no hurried pace,
just open skies and quiet space.
The hills, they teach with gentle breath,
A language deeper than mere death.
Here, in the calm, I learn to be,
In harmony with all I see.
The food, the fog, the hills that rise,
The endless stretch of open skies.
No words are needed, none are spoken,
For in this place, my soul's unbroken.
